questions: Did these abnormal hand movements start suddenly, within the last 24 hours?
Are the movements involuntary and difficult for you to control?
Do you also have weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Have you had facial drooping, trouble speaking, confusion, or trouble understanding speech?
Have you had a severe or unusual headache, dizziness, or loss of balance?
Have you lost consciousness or had a seizure?
Do you have fever or a recent infection?
Did you recently fall, hit your head, or otherwise injure yourself?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication?
Have you taken any new recreational drugs, stimulants, or excess caffeine?
Have you had similar movements or episodes before?
Do the movements improve when you are relaxed or asleep?
Do you have stiffness, slowness, tremor, or difficulty initiating movement?
Have you had abnormal blood sugar, kidney problems, liver problems, or thyroid disease?
Are you currently being treated in the hospital for a neurologic or medical condition?
Are you having chest pain, shortness of breath, or a racing or irregular heartbeat?
Is the device hanging from your neck connected to a medical monitor or treatment you are currently receiving?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder with abnormal involuntary movements (functional movement disorder)

ALTERNATIVE 1: Autoimmune encephalitis, particularly anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis

ALTERNATIVE 2: Infectious encephalitis

ALTERNATIVE 3: Drug-induced dyskinesia or chorea
